newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN SHIPPING TO COST UP TO 700 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN SHIPPING TO COST UP TO 700 MLN KROONS.

text.p: ESCO Holding offered 700 million kroons and Arbonale 620 million kroons in their bids to privatise Eesti Merelaevandus (Estonian Shipping Company), Eesti Paevaleht said on Monday.
ESCO Holding offered to invest invest 1.2 billion kroons in two years in the company and Arbonale offered to make an initial invesment of one billion kroons, the newspaper added.
ESCO Holding's business plan sees the development of commercial transport and transit services.
Arbonale wants to start intense cooperation with other Estonian ports and build a transit corridor between Russia and Europe.
The privatisation agency will make the decision on June 18.

Arbonale is held by Talinvest, Hansa Investments, N-Terminaal, Norwegian shipping company Navigator, Japanese investment bank Nomura, Hong Kong shipping company Jinhui Shipping and Transportation Ltd.
ESCO's Holding partners are Swedish investment company Carnigie, Norway's Tscudi & EITZEN Group, Balti Cresco and Epeks.
